text:
Anya: Quick intake — proposing cedar-14b for today's perf bring-up. Goal: latency/throughput baseline, quant int8 sweep, and 32k ctx smoke. Who can own?

Sam: I can own the baseline runs. Plan: 1) empty-cache single-client p50/p90 for batch=1..8, 2) throughput w/100 concurrent small requests, 3) ctx sweep 1k/4k/8k/16k/32k.

Kevin: I can run quantization experiments (dynamic + static int8, q4f). Will need evals for quality regressions vs fp16.

Rui: I'll wire up the dashboard panels for per-route latency and tokens/sec so we can compare directly. Can we standardize prompts?

Anya: Use the standard perf-prompt-set in repo: a mix of short completion (10-20 tokens), medium (60-150), and long (400-800) to exercise KV cache. Include a few code-style prompts.

Leo: bench-bot: scheduling run for cedar-14b on the dedicated pool at 12:30 PDT. Will post artifacts. :robot_face:

bench-bot: Scheduled cedar-14b perf-run on pool-dedicated-1, slot 3, ETA 12:30 PDT. Artifacts will be uploaded to s3://redwood-ci/cedar14b/perf/1851234567/

Sam: Quick checklist for runs so we don't forget things: 
- Model variant tags (fp16, int8-dyn, int8-static, q4f)
- Kernel flags: fused-attn=true/false
- Batch sizes: 1,2,4,8,16 (for throughput)
- Seq lengths: 128,512,2048,8192,32768
- Tokens/sec measured + p50/p90/p99 latencies
- Memory spill / OOM logs

Kevin: For quant static I'll try calibration using 500 inference steps across mixed prompt set. If quality drops > 2% exact-match or BLEU/ROUGE equivalent for our evals, we flag. How to surface evals?

Rui: I'll create a quick eval-run config pointing at eval-suite/perf-quality/cedar14b.yaml. Metrics: perplexity on heldout, exact match on code tasks, and our human-simulated ranking. If any metric regresses by >1.5-2% we add to regression list.

Anya: Nice. Also include streaming latency measurement (time to first token) for chat use-case. Target: ttf-token <= 45ms for batch=1 on p4d. If not met, fallback to smaller quant or fp16.

Sam: Sharing quick command snippets I'll run (feel free to reuse):
```bash
# single-client p50/p90 latency
python perf/run_inference.py --model cedar-14b --variant fp16 --batch 1 --seq 512 --concurrency 1 --mix prompts/standard.json --measure latency

# throughput test
python perf/run_inference.py --model cedar-14b --variant fp16 --batch 8 --seq 128 --concurrency 100 --duration 300 --measure throughput
```

Kevin: For quant runs: 
```bash
python quant/convert.py --model cedar-14b --mode static --calib-samples 500 --out cedar14b-int8-static
python perf/run_inference.py --model cedar-14b --variant cedar14b-int8-static --batch 1 --seq 512 --measure latency
```

Leo: bench-bot: build started for cedar14b-int8-static. Will post logs to the run.

bench-bot: Build log: convert step finished. Size reduced from 28.7GB -> 8.2GB.

Sam: Early results (fp16, single client, seq512): p50=38ms, p90=82ms, tokens/sec=12.4k (batch=1). Throughput (batch=8, conc=100): steady tokens/sec=85k, 95th-latency=420ms. Putting raw CSVs in the artifacts.

Kevin: int8-dyn baseline (same test): p50=41ms, p90=95ms, tokens/sec=13.1k (batch=1). Quality delta: perplexity +1.1% vs fp16; code-exact-match -0.9%. Looks acceptable so far.

Rui: Uploaded dashboard link: https://console.redwood/teams/eng-ml/dashboards/cedar14b/1851234567 (short link). Panels show buffer fill during ctx=32k — we hit kernel fallback at 24k for one node (noted).

Anya: Flags: 
- One node had kernel fallback at ctx 24k, needs kernel selector tweak.
- Static int8 showed a small regression on long-code tasks (2.4% EM drop). Marking for deeper eval.

Kevin: Will run a refined calibration with code-heavy calibration set and retry static quant. Also will rerun model with fused-attn=false to see perf/quality tradeoff.

Sam: Action items assigned: 
- Sam: collect full latency CSVs and raw tokens/sec runs, post to artifact bucket (eta 13:15 PDT).
- Kevin: refine quant calibrations and produce new static variant (eta 14:30 PDT).
- Rui: adjust dashboard to surface kernel fallback and memory spike traces (eta 13:00 PDT).
- Anya: decision on onboard priority after quant quality check (eta 15:00 PDT).

Leo: bench-bot: run artifacts uploaded: s3://redwood-ci/cedar14b/perf/1851234567/{latency.csv,throughput.csv,quant-report.json,logs.tar.gz}.

Anya: Thanks team. If static int8 can't meet quality thresholds we keep int8-dyn as recommended deployment variant and defer static until further model edits. Will post final prioritization in this thread. :v:
